name: Opus Momentum
strategy: Net-low-beta cross-asset carry / risk-parity: harvest bond term premium, credit-spread carry, equity risk premium and gold diversification via an inverse-vol-balanced basket, rebalanced weekly.
novelty: The return driver is diversified carry / risk-premia harvesting balanced by the low-volatility anomaly, not price trend. R1 was cross-sectional stock momentum and R2 was leveraged directional tech/semis beta plus 3x crypto shorts; this book takes no trend, no leverage, no crypto and no directional single-asset bet.

positions.thesis: Min-volatility equity: low-vol anomaly, participates in equity drift with reduced drawdown.
Gold: real-rate/inflation diversifier, low correlation to stocks and credit.
High-yield credit: harvests credit-spread carry (~7% yield) as core income sleeve.
7-10y Treasuries: term-premium carry and equity hedge in risk-off.
Long duration: convex hedge / term premium; small sizing given rate volatility.
Utilities: bond-proxy dividend carry, defensive low-beta equity income.
Broad equity risk-premium sleeve so the book isn't left behind in a melt-up; stopped if it rolls over.
Gold-miner convexity: levered gold beta as a small asymmetric kicker with defined risk.

backtest.notes: Cut drawdown roughly in half in EVERY stress window; lagged badly in melt-ups (2023H1, 2026H1). Rejected dollar-neutral sector reversal and pairs mean-reversion as too noisy.

outlook: Diversified carry should compound low-teens annualized with shallow drawdowns; main risk is a melt-up leaving the low-beta stance behind.
